title: MedJev：评估医学中的零样本System-One决策
summary: 研究评估可在笔记本本地运行的开源System One模型MedJev，在十项医学基准上测试。MedQA准确率72.5%、USMLE 75.4%、NEJM 80.1%，接近GPT-4；院内死亡AUROC 0.926超过XGBoost，但患者级预测校准差，作者提出两参数重校准法将ECE降至0.007。
summary_en: This work evaluates MedJev, an open System One model running locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks. It reaches 72.5% on MedQA, 75.4% on USMLE, and 80.1% on NEJM, approaching GPT-4, and 0.926 AUROC for in-hospital mortality, beating XGBoost, though patient-level predictions are miscalibrated; a two-parameter recalibration method cuts ECE to 0.007.
